messages:
deploybot: ALERT: prod-embeddings canary exhibiting elevated tail latency after config drift detection. Auto-rollback blocked (release pinned by PM). Hotfix candidate image: redwood/inference:2026-04-12-hf1. Requesting expedited unpin + canary roll. 20m change window requested. @sarah (PM) @sam (release lead) please ack.

sam: pinging ops + pm, put logs here?

deploybot: sample probe: /embed/v1 latency p95=320ms (baseline 220ms). error spikes small (<0.1%) but latency unacceptable for realtime SLAs.

fiona: this matches the quant config flip we shipped yesterday; hotfix reverts that flag + increases kv-ttl. Verified on canary-staging.

nate: infra check: nodes healthy, no disk pressure, ephemeral CPU burst at 14:02 UTC. No other rolling updates.

sarah: customers on dedicated clusters: notify? we have two active midmarket customers on EU region. If we unpin we should add note to changelog and send a short heads-up.

sam: agree. i'll take release-lead approval if ops and qa +1. We should constrain to canary 5% for 15m then ramp.

fiona: QA quick-check passed: smoke + embedding-sanity harness (1000 samples) green.

ops-oncall: i'm +1 from infra, but require deploybot guard rails: extended observe window, and freeze new deploys until finish. Also set rollback triggers: p95 > baseline*1.25 or errors > 0.5%.

sam: deploybot, queue command with override and guard rails. include audit note.

deploybot: queued: `/deploy release --image redwood/inference:2026-04-12-hf1 --scope canary --ramp 5% --observe 900s --auto-rollback-threshold "p95>+25% || errors>0.5%" --override-pin release-lead-sam --freeze-new-deploys --audit "unpin-for-embed-hf1"`

sarah: i'll update the changelog and send PM notice after approval.

sam: i'm +approve (expedite). release lead decision.

fiona: +1 from eng.

ops-oncall: +ack, freezing new deploys now.

deploybot: APPROVAL: release-lead sam and eng-signoff fiona. Lifting pin and starting canary. Will report every 2m.

deploybot: 14:24 UTC - canary 5% deployed. observing 15m.

nate: watching infra metrics, p95 initially 235ms -> 260ms at 2m. error rate stable.

sarah: changelog updated: https://go/release/2026-04-12-hf1. customer note drafted.

deploybot: 14:33 UTC - telemetry: p50/p95/p99 = 40ms/245ms/510ms (baseline 35/220/480). error rate 0.09%. within thresholds.

sam: ok to ramp to 50% over 5m?

ops-oncall: wait 2 more windows, want to see stability across 3 points.

fiona: agree with ops. hold on ramp.

deploybot: 14:38 UTC - telemetry check 2: p95 238ms, errors 0.07%. holding per ops request.

sam: thanks. ops, if still stable at 14:44 UTC i'll authorize ramp to 50%.

ops-oncall: 14:44 UTC - still stable. +approve ramp to 50%.

deploybot: starting ramp to 50% over 5m.

deploybot: 14:51 UTC - ramp complete: 50% traffic. telemetry p95=228ms, errors 0.05%.

sarah: sending customer heads-up now.

fiona: if no regression in next 10m we can finish ramp to 100% and close window.

sam: agreed. keep rollback thresholds enforced.

deploybot: 15:02 UTC - final telemetry: p95=215ms, errors 0.03%. within target. commencing final ramp to 100%.

deploybot: 15:10 UTC - rollout complete. pin removed and audit note saved: unpin-for-embed-hf1. New image redwood/inference:2026-04-12-hf1 active.

ops-oncall: unfreeze complete, resuming normal deploys.

sarah: customers notified and changelog published. closing change window.

fiona: follow-up: create a short postmortem and schedule revisit of quant rollout process.

sam: thanks all. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
